question: In which year was the city of Agra founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1504**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The city of Agra was founded in the year **1504**.
 
• The city was founded by **Sikandar Lodi**, the ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• Agra is located in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh in India.
 
• It is renowned for its historical and architectural significance, particularly the Taj Mahal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikandar Lodi**

 
 
• Sikandar Lodi was the Sultan of Delhi between 1489 and 1517.
 
• He was the second ruler of the Lodi Dynasty, succeeding his father, Bahlul Lodi.
 
• He is known for his administration and efforts to expand the Sultanate.
 
• He moved the capital from Delhi to Agra in 1504, which he founded as a new city.
 
 
 
• **Agra**
 
 
• Agra is a city on the banks of the Yamuna river.
 
• It is one of the most populous cities in Uttar Pradesh and a major tourist destination.
 
• The city is home to several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and Fatehpur Sikri.
 
• Agra has a rich history, having been the capital of the Mughal Empire and a focal point of the Indian rebellion of 1857.
 
 
 
• **Taj Mahal**
 
 
• The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the southern bank of the river Yamuna.
 
• It was commissioned in 1632 by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan to house the tomb of his favorite wife, Mumtaz Mahal.
 
• The Taj Mahal is universally admired for its architectural beauty and is considered one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
 
• It attracts millions of tourists from around the world each year.
